newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syrian, French leaders discuss Middle East peace.
newsitem.headline: Syrian, French leaders discuss Middle East peace.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac telephoned Syrian President Hafez al-Assad to discuss peace talks between Syria, Lebanon and Israel, official sources said.
They said the two leaders also discussed Syrian-French relations during the telephone conversation on Tuesday.
Chirac on Tuesday told visiting Lebanese Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri that stalled peace talks between Israel and its two Arab neighbors should resume.

Israel suspended sporadic talks with Syria nearly a year ago. Syria says Israel should return the Golan Heights, captured by Israel in 1967, before peace can be achieved in the region. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejects handing back the Golan.
